text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi! Tsurumaru 
Tsuyoshi! The winner is neither a Mejiro 
nor the Overlord!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Defeating his classmate Special Week, it's 
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi stepping closer to the 
Autumn crown!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...I won.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ahhh... I won...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Tsuru-chan.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan. ――...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
...!! Special Week reaches out her hand, 
and Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi takes it in return!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“Even as winners and losers are made! 
There is no denying they are of the same 
generation! Joining hands tightly, as if 
to reaffirm their bond—”

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: So frustraaaating!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Or so it seemed, but Special Week! She's 
suddenly started throwing a tantrum?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I'm still so frustrated! It's so 
frustrating! I was supposed to win! 
...Uggghhh~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Next time, I'm going to win...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. For the upcoming Tenno Sho 
(Autumn), it's my turn to lie in wait.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I won't let my guard down! I've seen 
Spe-chan's incredible finishing burst with 
my own eyes!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ......I know. That's my weapon!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Still, today was Tsuru-chan's victory! The 
winning Umamusume goes to the Winner's 
Circle, you know!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: “...... Yeah! Next time, Spe-chan!”

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...This generation is incredible. To think 
there are still such interesting talents 
out there...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh...! We're watching! We'll make sure 
to bear witness to your journey from here 
on!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa, Grass Wonder, King Halo, 
Seiun Sky! And with these two here as 
well—

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
I truly can't take my eyes off 
them—because this is the Golden 
Generation.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...*inhale*...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you all for your constant support!! 
It's me, Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi!!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"From here on out, please keep feeling the 
thrills for our future! Stay excited! Keep 
your hopes high!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I'll show you all kinds of possibilities!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi waved both hands 
vigorously toward the stands, full of 
boundless energy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her next goal is the Tenno Sho (Autumn). 
We head toward that autumn stage steeped 
in history and tradition.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...Man. This generation is just way too 
crazy.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whenever the weekend rolls around, there's 
always a thrilling race happening 
somewhere!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Right?! We have them here to put on the 
greatest battles Japan has ever seen!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan B
text_block_list.text:
And above all, in this generation, 
—there's even the highest level in the 
world!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That took place a few days before the 
Kyoto Daishoten, where Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi 
and the others fought their fierce battle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That day, Japan... no, the entire world 
went wild. Exclaiming that "there were two 
champions!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
2nd place in the pinnacle of the world, 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe. Achieved by 
El Condor Pasa, the phantom bird who took 
flight across the globe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One of Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's classmates 
from the same generation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The possibilities continue to expand even 
further.
